org.gradle.api.UnknownDomainObjectException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
UnknownConfigurationException, UnknownProjectException, UnknownRepositoryException, UnknownTaskException
public class UnknownDomainObjectException extends GradleException

A UnknownDomainObjectException is the super class of all exceptions thrown when a given domain object cannot be located.
